paper.title: EvolvingAgent: Curriculum Self-evolving Agent with Continual World Model for Long-Horizon Tasks
paper.central_claim: Curriculum self-evolving planner-controller-reflector with a continual world model autonomously updates multimodal experience/world knowledge and improves long-horizon Minecraft execution and Atari generalization.

evidence.support_explanation: Central claim: autonomous update of experiences and world knowledge (world-model parameters).

signatures.information: current state, goal, collected subtask-labelled experience; prior GPT-4o when replay empty
signatures.operation: extract relevant trajectories after subtask failure; form input/success-label pairs; fine-tune planner
signatures.conditions: matching task labels and online fine-tuning available
signatures.selection_rule: label matching, not validated prompt edit acceptance
signatures.persistence: LoRA parameter state; agent reinitializes on death
signatures.failure_boundary: weight-based, no independent persistent inference-time prompt edit established

signatures.information: transitions, subtask completion, TD errors, gradients and old/new world-model predictions
signatures.operation: append completed/timeout episodes; two-stage curriculum selects subtasks and experiences; gradient update plus Fisher regularization
signatures.conditions: online RL environment and trainable model
signatures.feedback: environment transition/reward and model prediction mismatch
signatures.selection_rule: thresholded curriculum priorities, not harness artifact promotion
signatures.persistence: world-model weights and raw training buffer
signatures.later_use: predict state and select low-level actions
signatures.failure_boundary: no retained non-weight editing mechanism isolated

gap.author_gap: Human-created curricula and static experience/world knowledge impede autonomous LH task learning and cause forgetting.
gap.checked_gap: A concrete online-RL replay-selection/continual-model-learning problem; not demonstrated as a non-weight harness bottleneck.
lineage: DreamerV3 RSSM → goal-conditioned controller and curriculum-weighted replay
Voyager/Jarvis-1/Optimus-1 discussed as planning/memory comparators in I/II; their independently fixed full texts are not supplied
gap.residue: Forgetting and inefficient exploration under sparse long-horizon rewards.
gap.method_response: Two-level sample prioritization, world-model regularization and planner fine-tuning.
gap.remaining_gap: No context-only retained-harness contribution certified; cross-domain transfer attribution remains separate.
unresolved: Independent version-pinned comparator full texts are absent; request only if scope adjudication needs expanded neighbor check.

claims.text: Autonomous curriculum self-evolution improves LH task execution.
claims.baseline_control: PPO, GPT-4V, Jarvis-1, DreamerV3, LS-Imagine, Optimus-1; module ablations
claims.selection_vs_test: online replay used for training; not a sealed retained-harness test
claims.result_denominator: Table I overall SR 30.29 averaged across Iron/Gold/Diamond; Table III 10-seed ablations
counterevidence: These task improvements do not establish non-weight harness improvement.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Author reports online training-system results; out-of-scope does not deny those numerical results.
